name: Boston College

athletics.revShareNotes: Opted in; House settlement cap $20.5M in 2025-26 (≈$21.3M in 2026-27 after 4% escalator); reported full or near-full cap (not verified; private-school estimates).

name: University of California, Berkeley

athletics.revShareNotes: Opted in; House settlement cap $20.5M in 2025-26 (≈$21.3M in 2026-27 after 4% escalator); committed to the cap despite a structural deficit (exact payout not verified).

ratingNotes: FB: Justin Wilcox (2017-25) — 6-7 in 2023 and 2024; fired late in 2025; Tosh Lupoi (Oregon DC, ex-Cal player/assistant) hired (verify). Ron Rivera named football GM (2025). 2026 season-to-date results not verified for this snapshot. MBB: Mark Madsen — losing records 2024 & 2025. WBB: Charmin Smith, NCAA 2025. Olympic: Directors' Cup No. 24 in 2024-25 (verified); swimming, rugby, water polo, rowing. Revenue/expense gap reflects institutional-support deficit.
notes: Joined the ACC in 2024 with Stanford at roughly 30% of a full media share (rising to ~70% in year 8, ~75% year 9, full in year 10); cross-country travel for every sport. Structural athletics deficit (~$30M+/yr reported) and ~$400M+ Memorial Stadium retrofit/Simpson Center debt are a UC Regents and campus-budget issue — pressure to cut sports. Big Game vs. Stanford. ESPN College GameDay in Berkeley (Oct 2024) symbolized the new ACC.
note: AD and football coach not web-verified.

name: Clemson University

athletics.revShareNotes: Opted in; House settlement cap $20.5M in 2025-26 (≈$21.3M in 2026-27 after 4% escalator); full cap.

ratingNotes: FB: Dabo Swinney — 2016 & 2018 national titles, six straight CFP trips (2015-20); 9-4 (2023), 10-4 with 2024 ACC title and CFP first-round loss at Texas; disappointing 2025 (~7-6, approx.) despite a top-5 preseason ranking. 2026 season-to-date results not verified for this snapshot. MBB: Brad Brownell — Elite Eight 2024, #5 seed R1 loss to McNeese 2025. Olympic: baseball, golf, track — Directors' Cup roughly top-50. Facilities: elite football complex; renovated Littlejohn.
notes: Sued the ACC (Mar 2024) over grant-of-rights/exit costs; settled with FSU and the ACC in March 2025 — exit costs fall to roughly $75M from 2026 and step down annually (see conferences/legal agent for the schedule) and a partly viewership/brand-based revenue model rewards Clemson. South Carolina legislature and trustees closely aligned with athletics (IPTAY). A top-tier SEC/Big Ten target if the ACC unravels; Palmetto Bowl with South Carolina.

notes: Elite private AAU university (US News #7) whose basketball brand outweighs football, making Duke a 'basketball-first' realignment asset usually paired with UNC. Methodist heritage; no state pressure. The Mensah lawsuit (2026) is a test of whether revenue-share/NIL player contracts are enforceable — a useful event seed.

notes: Five national titles (1983-2001) give a national brand; plays off campus at the Dolphins' Hard Rock Stadium. Booster John Ruiz (LifeWallet) pioneered public NIL spending 2022-24; deep-pocketed trustees fund Cristobal's roster. Private school (low state pressure), but the South Florida market (#17 DMA) makes Miami a premium SEC/Big Ten target. AAU membership reported from 2023 (verify).

athletics.revShareNotes: Opted in; House settlement cap $20.5M in 2025-26 (≈$21.3M in 2026-27 after 4% escalator); full cap, backed by a ~$229M multiyear athletics investment plan approved in 2025.

Board of Visitors approved a ~$229M athletics investment plan (2025). Any UVA departure triggers 'VT must come too' politics. Franklin hire is a statement of ambition.
